scope: Experimental application-local slide renderer, separate from non-executing Flutter shadow IPC. No OS input backend, no training, no real-camera test.
positive_execution_test_evidence: Programmatic contract simulations with untrained analytical MLP/TCN and in-memory provenance copies ONLY. No fake real-model packages are written; this is not camera recognition evidence.
verified_invariants: explicit CLI opt-in; camera requires C; enable and neutral-owner request are separate
synthetic models rejected by live demo, existing shadow cannot dispatch
owner context reset requires fresh model window and release
single local page command per motion; release before another gesture
stale model input cannot be replaced by a UI heartbeat
stop bypasses blocked inference; late output does not change page
old rendered receipt cannot reenable a stopped context
PNG/JPEG ordering, pixel/byte/count limits and path containment
receipt-based model handoff does not overwrite local training pointers
